title: decade speaks a socket protocol to decade-aware apps
body:
decade has no socket. In `src/compositor.rs` the only inter-process channel
is the Wayland socket that `ListeningSocketSource::new_auto` opens, and the
only client is the ghostty that `spawn_terminal` starts.

## Proposal

A second unix socket, at a path decade puts in the environment of every
process it spawns as `DECADE_SOCKET`, carrying newline-delimited JSON in
both directions. JSON lines so that a decade-aware tool can be written in
any language in an afternoon; a binary encoding only if a measurement ever
asks for it.

- Handshake: the client's first line names itself and what it can do, such
  as `{"hello": {"name": "code-pane", "accepts": ["show", "mark"]}}`.
  decade answers with the pane the client occupies, if any.
- Addressing: every message after that carries a target pane, by the name
  decade assigned or by role, so the chat can say "the code pane" without
  knowing which window it is.
- First messages, enough for the code pane and follow-along:
  `show { path, line }`, `mark { path, lines }`, `clear`.
- Errors: a line back with the offending message and a reason, never
  silence.

decade routes: a message for a pane goes to the client occupying it. A
message for decade itself, such as focus, is handled in the compositor.

## Rejected

- Escape sequences over the pty. Structured two-way messages do not fit
  them; see the closed decision decade-f51dcd.
- One socket per pane. A single socket with addressing is simpler for the
  chat, which talks to several panes.

## Open

- Whether a client may occupy a pane it did not open, such as a code pane
  started by the chat.
- Versioning of the message set, since external tools will depend on it.
close_reason: Done in the commit titled 'Open a socket for decade-aware programs' on dev, 2026-11-06, described in docs/protocol.md. The open question of which pane a client may claim is answered by DECADE_PANE: decade names the pane in the environment of what it starts, the client hands the name back in hello, and a pane already held by another client is refused. Versioning is a number in welcome, 1 now, moving only when a message changes shape. Checked live against a Python client: hello, panes, a forwarded show, focus moving on screen, and the error for an unoccupied pane.
